landed_against.rule: R-17: this slice declares every diff path here and re-captures all three baselines in the same commit.

what_landed: A summoned unit's attack count is derived from its own cadence over the fight window (champions/pet_window.py) instead of being frozen at one window's declared reading. Ivern's Daisy and Zyra's plants land first; the option stays as an override for what the clock cannot know.
why: Daisy's declared 6 attacks was her RANK 3 cadence applied at every rank: 0.75 base attack speed plus 30/45/60% by R rank gives 4, 5 and 6 attacks in a five-second window. The golden fights at level 11 hold R rank 2, so they price 5 and every Ivern total falls by one Daisy attack.

Zyra's plant count is now bounded by the plant's own sourced life, read from Q's cached sentence rather than from a comment: 0.8 attack speed over 8 seconds is 6 attacks, and a five-second fight still prices the 4 it always did.
Neither count moved for the right reason before: a thirty-second fight bought the same six Daisy swings as a five-second one.

qualifying_population.rule: Only the two kits whose pet rows this slice derives qualify, and the champions that moved are: Ivern.

/metadata/fingerprint/leaves.cause: no leaf is added or removed; the counters move only if a row's shape did

summary.direction: down for Ivern, whose Daisy priced a rank-3 cadence at every rank; unchanged for Zyra inside a five-second fight

described_leaves.rule: Amendment E: each claimed disposition transition names the leaf it describes and the values on both sides.
